title: Complete rounds keep backed pairs, and peel back exactly
claim: Theorem 1: every stage of round >= 1 under complete rounds from a connected start has its live junctions pairwise apart (P2) and backed pairs (P1+: any two junctions a live junction meets also meet a junction holding no loose distinction). Theorem 2: removing the live junctions of an open stage gives the previous stage exactly, so the peel depth of a round-r open stage is at least r. Theorem 3: on the previous stage distinctions, the next open stage never lengthens a bond distance.
standard_statement: Complete-round joining of even-parity constraints: constraints with a free variable are pairwise variable-disjoint, their neighbours pairwise share a further neighbour with no free variable; deleting them gives the previous stage; least cocircuits through old variables never grow.
prior_work: FRESH-COUNT-20261118-001A and FIRST-KNOT-20261118-001A (the joining rule); Whitney 2-isomorphism (used in ticket B).
